commentary.text: 90+3' That's the end of the match.
90+2' 0 - 4 Goal! 0:4. The ball rebounds to Goduine Koyalipou (Levante) after a melee in the box, and he easily beats the keeper from close range.
90' There will be a minimum of 3 min. of added time.
86' Alex Moreno (Girona) blasts the ball from just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by the defender.
83' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Girona.
82' The number of shots on goal at present is 1:5.
77' It’s time for the cooling break for the players to take on some fluids. It’s hot out there!
75' The referee signals a substitution. Bryan Gil (Girona) is brought on as a substitute for Azzedine Ounahi.
74' Matias Moreno (Levante) connects with a cross from out wide in the six-yard box, but only plants his header onto the right post.
73' The ball goes behind for a corner. Levante will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
73' The corner is swung in but Levante can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
72' Substitution. Carlos Alvarez makes his way off the pitch and Kervin Arriaga (Levante) comes on as his replacement.
72' Julian Calero prepares a substitution. Etta Eyong is replaced by Goduine Koyalipou (Levante).
71' Here comes a substitution. Pablo Martinez Andres (Levante) is brought on as a substitute for Ivan Romero.
71' Julian Calero has decided to substitute Oriol Rey and he is replaced by Jose Morales (Levante).
70' 0 - 3 Goal! Ivan Romero (Levante) finds himself some space inside the box to get on the end of a pass from Etta Eyong, then sends the ball into the bottom right corner. 0:3.

68' Jhon Elmer Solis Romero (Girona) gets inside the box and tries to beat Mathew Ryan with a measured shot into the left side of the goal, but the keeper is equal to the effort and makes a fine save.
65' Unai Elgezabal Udondo (Levante) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Alejandro Quintero blows his whistle for a foul.
62' Hugo Rincon (Girona) is punished with the yellow card.
57' Manu Sanchez (Levante) has tested the patience of referee Alejandro Quintero and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
56' The attendance is 11048.
56' Ivan Romero (Levante) creates a good chance for himself and fires in a powerful close-range shot, but his effort ricochets off the right post.
55' Substitution. Unai Vencedor did his best and is replaced by Jon Ander Olasagasti (Levante).
55' Levante take a short corner kick.
53' We are about to witness a substitution. Portu (Girona) is replacing Joel Roca.
53' Here is a change. Vladyslav Vanat is going off and Michel gives the last tactical orders to Jhon Elmer Solis Romero (Girona).
52' A cross from a corner kick by Girona is too strong and the ball goes well out of play.
52' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Girona, is intercepted by one of the defenders. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Girona.

49' 0 - 2 Carlos Alvarez (Levante) struck with a perfectly taken free kick from the edge of the box. He curled the ball straight inside the left post. There are not enough superlatives that can be used to describe that goal.
48' Carlos Alvarez (Levante) is able to continue to play.
47' Carlos Alvarez (Levante) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
46' The referee interrupts the game and gives Vitor Reis (Girona) a red card. No amount of arguing will help him escape the punishment.
46' Here is a change after the half-time break. Arnau Martinez (Girona) is replaced by Alejandro Frances.
46' The need to improve in the second half has brought about a change. Yaser Asprilla (Girona) comes off for Hugo Rincon.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+7' Alejandro Quintero blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45+5' The Levante players are exchanging some short passes.
45+4' Girona can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
45+3' Alex Moreno (Girona) goes on a mazy run and tries his luck with a mid-range strike, but one of the defending players steps in and makes a block. Good work from Girona as they win a corner.
45' The fourth official shows 6 min. of added time.
43' 0 - 1 Etta Eyong (Levante) heads the ball inside the left post after a splendid cross. This timely header produces a wonderful moment.
42' Yaser Asprilla (Girona) lashes the free kick from the edge of the box but it flies high over the bar, somewhere into the stands. The ball goes out of play and Levante will have a goal kick.
40' Oriol Rey (Levante) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision! Girona have a free kick.

40' Roger Brugue (Levante) had a good opportunity when he latched on to a cross from the wing, but his header from the six-yard box wasn't accurate enough and the ball glanced away off the right post.
39' Levante work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
37' Carlos Alvarez (Levante) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Alejandro Quintero had an easy-decision to make.
36' Alex Moreno (Girona) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent.
33' Unai Vencedor (Levante) has picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue.
30' Unai Vencedor (Levante) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
30' RED CARD! Axel Witsel (Girona) makes a bad challenge and receives a second yellow card from Alejandro Quintero. He can have an early bath.
29' Unai Elgezabal Udondo (Levante) makes a strong challenge and Alejandro Quintero blows for a foul.
27' Levante control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
24' Alejandro Quintero shows a yellow card to Unai Vencedor (Levante) for his blatant foul.
23' Yaser Asprilla (Girona) makes an unfair challenge by holding his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball.
21' Girona seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
18' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Axel Witsel (Girona) was quite harsh and Alejandro Quintero didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
17' Girona have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.

14' Carlos Alvarez (Levante) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Alejandro Quintero with no other option than to blow for a foul.
12' Arnau Martinez (Girona) is disappointed with himself because he got into a good area but produced a poor cross.
10' Levante are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player. The possession of the ball – 34:66.
8' Yellow card. Arnau Martinez (Girona) goes into the referee's book after a bad challenge.
7' Yaser Asprilla (Girona) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Alejandro Quintero blows for a foul.
4' Close! Joel Roca (Girona) picks up the ball in space and from inside the penalty area sends a shot inches wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Levante.
3' Oriol Rey (Levante) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Alejandro Quintero has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
2' Girona quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
2' Arnau Martinez (Girona) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
1' The match has just started.
The players are out at last! Girona will take the kick-off.
Alejandro Quintero is introduced as the referee for today's match.
